items: (a) Check that the throttle linkage moves smoothly.

items: (b) Check the vacuum at each port.
• Check the vacuum with your finger.

content.description: Illustration showing vacuum port check locations on throttle body with numbered ports

items: (a) Check the resistance between the terminals.
• Unplug the connector from the sensor.
• Insert a thickness gauge between the throttle stop screw and stop lever.
• Using an ohmmeter, check the resistance between each terminal.
